name: X Brief
description: Links to your X account, works out your subject area from what you've posted lately, then monitors that territory and mails a short round-up at the close of each weekday. Requires a reasonably established posting history to infer a beat, and only delivers on weekdays.

official.title: X Brief by Daniel
official.description: An end-of-day brief on what's moving in your corner of X, plus a playbook built from your own best posts: what works, fill-in-the-blank templates, and...
